snippet.title: SMBX - Level Collection - Final Trailer
snippet.description:
It's finally here! 

Join Mario and explore 20+ imaginative levels! From boiling factories to celestial canyons, frozen peaks to haunted casinos, you'll discover something new in every level! Run, jump & collect Power Stars in this SMBX Level Collection, out now! 

DOWNLOAD LINK: https://www.smbxgame.com/forums/viewtopic.php?t=27751

Special thanks to Aristo, Darknonius64, Enjl, snoruntpyro & Waddle for helping me out with this episode.

The song used in the trailer is called Create and is sung by Japanese song artist Gen Hoshino. Translation of the song is from the official music video.

Music Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=74FIsXlS0EQ

NOTE: This video has been copyright claimed and has ads being played by the copyright holder. I'm not making any money on this video.
